name: herb-and-hue
description: Herb & Hue — premium botanical skincare storefront, API and admin dashboard

scripts.dev: node scripts/run.mjs concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
